title: Dick Burbage
html_source: Richard Burbage, (born c. 1567, London—died March 9/13, 1619, London, Eng.), English actor, first player of Shakespeare’s Richard III, Romeo, Henry V, Hamlet, Macbeth, Othello, and Lear. Shakespeare was closely associated with him during his career in London and in his will left Burbage a token remembrance.
